name: clipboard.set
description: Replace the current text contents of the system clipboard. Overwrites whatever is there — classified U.

content.description: Text to place on the clipboard.

windows-modern.description: OpenClipboard + EmptyClipboard + SetClipboardData(CF_UNICODETEXT, hMem). Memory handed to the OS; agent does not free.

windows-classic.description: Same Win32 sequence. Emits both CF_UNICODETEXT and CF_TEXT (active code page) so pre-NT-5 readers can consume the value.
